cells.n: ἐπαγγελία is a compound word; tokens [4]+[5] represent the single Greek word ἐπαγγελία (G1860), but the tagging has split the prefix ἐπ (G1909) from the root αγγελία (G31). Treating as the complete word 'message/announcement'.
absorbed into token [4] as part of ἐπαγγελία
tagged G1510 but is clearly the relative pronoun ἥν (accusative feminine singular of ὅς)
copula already supplied in brackets in token [16]
plural of G4151; 'Spirits' (capitalized) refers to supernatural beings whose origin must be discerned; context requires testing whether they are from God
